response.text:
I can do that — please upload the product photo first (I need the original to perform the edit). A couple quick clarifications so I get exactly what you want:

- I will remove the window glare from the bottle but will not change any printed text on the label (word-for-word preserved).
- I will change the background to a warm gray and crop/output a square catalog shot.
- What output format and size do you want? (e.g., JPEG or PNG; e.g., 2000 x 2000 px). If you don't specify I'll deliver a high-resolution JPEG, 2000×2000 px.
- Do you want me to keep any natural shadow/reflection under the bottle (recommended for realism) or remove all reflections completely?
- Any other retouching to avoid (color changes to the bottle, logo sharpening, etc.)?

Upload the image and confirm the format/size and shadow preference, and I’ll start.
